metrics.label: API well number
metrics.help: The 10, 12 or 14 digit API number of the well.

metrics.label: Permit or application number
metrics.help: The agency's own permit, application or tracking number.

metrics.label: Well name and number
metrics.help: Name and number of the well, as in 'Smith 1-H'.

metrics.label: Lease, unit or property name
metrics.help: The lease, unit or property the well belongs to.

metrics.label: Operator name
metrics.help: Who will drill and run the well.

metrics.label: Operator registration number
metrics.help: The agency's operator ID (P-5 number in Texas, OGRID in New Mexico).

metrics.label: Operator business type
metrics.help: Corporation, LLC, partnership, individual and so on.

metrics.label: Financial assurance (bond)
metrics.help: Bond or other financial assurance on file for the operator or the well.

metrics.label: County, parish or borough
metrics.help: Where the well is located.

metrics.label: Agency district or region
metrics.help: The agency's own district, region or field office.

metrics.label: Field or pool
metrics.help: Field, pool or play the well is in or targets.

metrics.label: Surface latitude and longitude
metrics.help: Coordinates of the surface location.

metrics.label: Section, township, range or footages
metrics.help: Legal land description or footages from lease lines.

metrics.label: Bottom-hole location
metrics.help: Where the wellbore ends (or the end of the lateral).

metrics.label: Directional path or survey
metrics.help: Planned or measured wellbore path.

metrics.label: Ground or KB elevation
metrics.help: Elevation of the ground or the kelly bushing.

metrics.label: Surface owner or use
metrics.help: Surface ownership, surface use agreement or notice to the surface owner.

metrics.label: Well type or purpose
metrics.help: Oil, gas, injection, disposal, service, stratigraphic test...

metrics.label: Type of work
metrics.help: New drill, re-entry, deepen, sidetrack, recompletion, plug back...

metrics.label: Vertical, directional or horizontal
metrics.help: How the well is drilled.

metrics.label: Proposed total depth (measured)
metrics.help: Planned measured depth.

metrics.label: True vertical depth
metrics.help: Planned vertical depth.

metrics.label: Lateral length
metrics.help: Planned horizontal length.

metrics.label: Target formation
metrics.help: The producing zone aimed at.

metrics.label: Expected formation tops
metrics.help: Geologic markers or tops expected on the way down.

metrics.label: Casing program
metrics.help: Casing sizes, depths and weights.

metrics.label: Cementing program
metrics.help: Cement volumes and tops.

metrics.label: Blowout preventer / pressure control
metrics.help: BOP type and test plan.

metrics.label: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S)
metrics.help: H2S expected, concentration or a contingency plan.

metrics.label: Pit and drilling-waste plan
metrics.help: Pits, closed loop, cuttings and fluid disposal.

metrics.label: Water source or volume
metrics.help: Where drilling and frac water comes from, and how much.

metrics.label: Hydraulic fracturing plan
metrics.help: Planned stimulation or chemical disclosure at permit time.

metrics.label: Spacing unit, acreage or pooling
metrics.help: Drilling or spacing unit, acres assigned, pooling or unitization order.

metrics.label: Exception to spacing or setback rules
metrics.help: A request for an exception, with its basis.

metrics.label: Mineral or lease ownership
metrics.help: Who owns the minerals or holds the lease.

metrics.label: Permit fee
metrics.help: The fee paid with the application.

metrics.label: Public notice, hearing or protest
metrics.help: Notice to offset owners, a hearing, or a comment period.

metrics.label: Date filed or received
metrics.help: When the application reached the agency.

metrics.label: Date approved or issued
metrics.help: When the permit was approved or issued.

metrics.label: Permit expiration date
metrics.help: When the permit lapses if not used.

metrics.label: Spud date
metrics.help: When drilling started.

metrics.label: Completion date
metrics.help: When the well was completed.

metrics.label: Well or permit status
metrics.help: Permitted, drilling, active, plugged...

metrics.label: Plat or location survey image
metrics.help: A scanned or digital plat online.

metrics.label: Application form image
metrics.help: The filed application itself, online.

metrics.label: Completion report or forms
metrics.help: Completion paperwork online.

metrics.label: Well logs
metrics.help: Logs filed with the agency.

metrics.label: Link to production reports
metrics.help: Production by well or lease from the same agency.
